## Ouvrages généraux

Box, G. E. P., Hunter, J. S., & Hunter, W. G. (2005). *Statistics for Experimenters: Design, Innovation, and Discovery* (2nd ed.). Wiley.

Dean, A., Voss, D., & Draguljić, D. (2017). *Design and Analysis of Experiments* (2nd ed.). Springer.

Hinkelmann, K., & Kempthorne, O. (2008). *Design and Analysis of Experiments* (Vols. 1–2). Wiley.

Kirk, R. E. (2013). *Experimental Design: Procedures for the Behavioral Sciences* (4th ed.). Sage.

Kutner, M. H., Nachtsheim, C. J., Neter, J., & Li, W. (2005). *Applied Linear Statistical Models* (5th ed.). McGraw-Hill.

Maxwell, S. E., Delaney, H. D., & Kelley, K. (2018). *Designing Experiments and Analyzing Data: A Model Comparison Perspective* (3rd ed.). Routledge.

Montgomery, D. C. (2020). *Design and Analysis of Experiments* (10th ed.). Wiley.

## Analyse de la variance

Keppel, G., & Wickens, T. D. (2004). *Design and Analysis: A Researcher's Handbook* (4th ed.). Pearson.

Rutherford, A. (2011). *ANOVA and ANCOVA: A GLM Approach* (2nd ed.). Wiley.

Winer, B. J., Brown, D. R., & Michels, K. M. (1991). *Statistical Principles in Experimental Design* (3rd ed.). McGraw-Hill.

## Carrés moyens attendus et quasi-\(F\)

Cornfield, J., & Tukey, J. W. (1956). Average values of mean squares in factorials. *Annals of Mathematical Statistics, 27*, 907–949.

Satterthwaite, F. E. (1946). An approximate distribution of estimates of variance components. *Biometrics Bulletin, 2*(6), 110–114.

## Logiciels

R Core Team. (2026). *R: A Language and Environment for Statistical Computing*. R Foundation for Statistical Computing, Vienna, Austria.

Wickham, H., Çetinkaya-Rundel, M., & Grolemund, G. (2023). *R for Data Science* (2nd ed.). O'Reilly Media.

## Lectures complémentaires

Cochran, W. G., & Cox, G. M. (1992). *Experimental Designs* (2nd ed.). Wiley.

Milliken, G. A., & Johnson, D. E. (2009). *Analysis of Messy Data, Volume I: Designed Experiments* (2nd ed.). Chapman & Hall/CRC.
